content: Advance M0110/W0113 by adding a host-independent guest data-plane ring adapter. Validate the paired shared-memory submission/completion rings, registry-view and queue-generation identity, payload bounds, and the BAR2 doorbell publication callback; prove success/backpressure/malformed paths without claiming live QEMU, physical PCI, or NVIDIA qualification.

Content revision 9a5cb6b adds the C17 vfio-user guest paired-ring adapter. It attaches the generated submission/completion mappings through the existing fastpath, checks queue IDs, registry-view identity, generation, and capacity, exposes payload bounds and wait/consume wrappers, and invokes the injected BAR2 doorbell callback only after successful submission. Malformed attach, invalid descriptors, ring backpressure, completion polling, and callback ordering regressions pass; focused guest CTest passed 1/1 and full development CTest passed 84/84. Live QEMU/libvfio-user, BAR2 MMIO, MSI-X, DMA lifetime, and physical NVIDIA qualification remain open; Agent Harness (codex) is both commit author and committer.
